name: the offer is no longer required, only an application
a withdrawn application still opens the document
any employer can read any applicant's documents
the employer policy stops naming the job's poster
the owner policy stops checking the folder
the employer policy is not read-only
from:
create policy "employers read an applicant's offered documents"
  on storage.objects for select
to:
create policy "employers read an applicant's offered documents"
  on storage.objects for all

name: the CV columns are not added
from: add column if not exists cv_path text,
to: add column if not exists cv_path_unused text,

name: industry is not added
from: add column if not exists industry text,
to: add column if not exists industry_unused text,

name: the application flags are not added
from: add column if not exists use_saved_cv boolean not null default false,
to: add column if not exists use_saved_cv_unused boolean not null default false,

name: the saved-documents function forgets whose application it is
from:
where id = p_application
    and applicant_id = auth.uid();

name: the saved-documents function does not set the flags
the anon grant that Supabase adds by default is left in place
